''See also: [[Navigators (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are a powerful [[Guild]] within the [[Elder Empire]] that possesses the unique ability to traverse the dangerous [[Aion Sea]]. Because they are the only force capable of crossing these waters at will, members of the [[Guild]] often accumulate significant wealth. Their specialized vessels are one-of-a-kind [[Awakened objects]], and their captains maintain such high levels of control over their ships that they can operate with very small crews. This efficiency makes passage on a [[Navigator vessel]] a highly valuable commodity, often used as a form of currency or for high-level negotiations. [[The Guild]]'s ability to navigate the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]] is not due to traditional seafaring skills, but rather their use of [[Elders]]. [[Navigator ships]] utilize bound Elder creatures to guide them through the sea and protect the vessel from other [[Elderspawn]], which allows for much faster travel. While some view them as dishonest or even as pirates, they remain essential for any maritime business involving the [[Aion]]. While most operate under the [[Guild]]'s structure, there are independent Navigators who possess their own unique vessels. Generally, Navigators only travel to locations where they have been specifically requested.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|As members of the Imperialist alliance, the Navigators are a group that individuals may join in pursuit of adventure and excitement. Capable of following ships into the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]], the organization was tasked with searching for a vanishing vessel. During this period, [[Calder]] was banished to the group, and the Navigators eventually began recalling to the Capital to stock up on supplies.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Navigators is a group one can join for excitement and adventure.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Navigators are recalling to the Capital and stocking up on supplies.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Navigators are a group capable of following ships into the [[Deep Aion|deep Aion]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are a [[Guild]]-organized group that performs the same functions as the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Sleepless]]. Led by [[Cheska Bennett]], members of this organization compete amongst themselves to serve as the voice for their [[Guild]]. During the events involving the [[Regent]], the group was hired to provide transportation for the crown. In certain visions, the vessels of ordinary ships began to take on the appearance of those belonging to the Navigators.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are a group that does exactly what the [[Sleepless]] and [[Blackwatch]] do.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are a group that will compete to speak for their [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Regent]] hired the Navigators to transport the crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are led by [[Cheska Bennett]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ordinary ships in the vision began to look like those of the Navigators.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Navigators are organized into a [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
